1. Every controller route is wrapped by AuthMiddleware.protect(); patient-scoped
2. Only representative dependencies are drawn, for readability.
3. Object valued references are modelled as associations. The User to Patient
and User to Caregiver relationship is shown as a generalisation, implemented
as a one to one reference.
Generalisation (is-a), hollow triangle at the superclass
Dependency (uses-a), arrow points at the supplier
Composition (part-of), filled diamond at the whole
UML note, attached by a dashed line
Association name, written on the line
